create_glm46v_config: create a Glm46VConfig with custom text and vision model configurations for multi-modal inference
build_glm46v_model: build a Glm46VModel that combines visual and language model components for conditional generation
run_glm46v_conditional_generation: run Glm46VForConditionalGeneration to produce text outputs conditioned on image or video input
sample_glm46v_video_frames: sample frames from video metadata using dynamic FPS thresholds and temporal patch sizing for Glm46VVideoProcessor
replace_glm46v_frame_token: replace frame tokens in Glm46VProcessor with timestamped image boundary markers
